toolsPage.heading: Tools
toolsPage.subtitle: Free, works entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded anywhere
toolsPage.photoResizerDesc: Crop and resize any photo to an exact pixel size and file size — pick a common preset (passport photo, signature) or set your own.
toolsPage.nameDatePhotoDesc: Add your name and today's date onto a photo, positioned exactly where you want it.
toolsPage.signatureMergeDesc: Overlay your signature onto a photo — with optional white-background removal so it blends in cleanly.

photoResizerPage.heading: Photo & Signature Resizer
photoResizerPage.body: Upload a photo, choose a preset or set your own size, then drag the box to crop. We'll resize to the exact dimensions and compress to fit the target file size.

nameDatePhotoPage.heading: Name & Date on Photo
nameDatePhotoPage.body: Upload a photo, type your name and date, and drag the label to position it. Download the finished photo when you're happy with it.

signatureMergePage.heading: Merge Signature on Photo
signatureMergePage.body: Upload a photo and your signature, then drag and resize the signature onto the photo. Turn on background removal if your signature was scanned on white paper.

eligibilityCheckerPage.heading: Eligibility Checker
eligibilityCheckerPage.body: Select a job and enter your details. We'll show exactly which conditions you meet — and which you don't, with the reason why.
